title: On Mersenne-Bernoulli and Mersenne-Euler polynomials
summary: The sequence of Mersenne numbers $\{M_n\}_{n\geq 0}$ is defined as $M_n = 2^n-1.$ In this study we introduce the Mersenne-Bernoulli and Mersenne-Euler polynomials. Using the generating functions and $M$-calculus we find some identities associated with them. Moreover, we define the corresponding matrices with these polynomials, factorise them and find their inverses.
